channel.title: Game Seed Assets blog
channel.description: Notes on making, publishing and marketing game assets.

item.title: How to sell assets on the Unity Asset Store (what we wish we'd known)
item.description: A publisher's walkthrough of selling on the Unity Asset Store: the 70/30 split, the $4.99 minimum, key image sizes, packaging, review, pricing and the mistakes we made with 25+ packs.

item.title: How to market your game assets when nobody knows your name yet
item.description: Practical marketing for Unity and Unreal asset creators: store pages that convert, free assets as a funnel, YouTube tutorials, Discord support, your own site, and what we'd skip.

item.title: Reddit for Unity Asset Store creators: where to post, and how not to get removed
item.description: Which subreddits suit Unity asset creators, what their self-promotion rules actually say, and how to post clips, free packs and breakdowns without getting removed or ignored.

item.title: Unity Asset Store vs Fab vs itch.io: where should you sell your game assets?
item.description: Revenue split, audience, pricing rules, licences, payouts and upload effort compared for the Unity Asset Store (70/30), Fab (88/12) and itch.io (open revenue share), from a publisher on all three.

item.title: Key images, screenshots and trailers that sell Unity assets
item.description: The four Unity Asset Store key image sizes and their rules, how to design a card that reads at 420 pixels, captioned screenshots, and a 45-60 second trailer plan, using our own store media.
